payload.title: A site defines its own Story procedure
payload.description:
One global list of required steps gates every publish.

```gherkin
Feature: Per-site procedure

  Scenario: A satire Story follows the satire procedure
    Given a site whose procedure has no research packet step
    When a Story is created on that site
    Then its checklist has only that site's steps
    And it can publish when those steps are closed
```

**Needs Papyrus work:** PPY-7a61ca.
